author: Gene Holcombe
text: Sensors do not just fall off.  You installed it improperly

author: Bobby Stern
text:
This procedure works for me: 

wash/shower with Ivory soap. My normal soaps let the sensor slip off.

Wipe area with alcohol swab and let dry.

Insert sensor and hold for at least 20 seconds. Then gently but firmly push on sensor with two fingers for about 30 seconds.

I don’t want to jinx myself but doing the above hasn’t failed.
